rule CobaltStrike_Beacon
{
  meta:
    description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon configuration in memory or files"
    author = "SOC Team"
    reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    tlp = "amber"
  strings:
    $s1 = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 63 73 72 63 } // ".rcdata" section common in CS beacons
    $s2 = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
    $s3 = "Accept: */*" wide ascii
    $x1 = { FF E0 } // JMP EAX
    $x2 = { 66 83 C0 ?? 66 3D ?? ?? 75 ?? } // Common string decryption loop
  condition:
    (uint16(0) == 0x5A4D) and all of ($s*) and 2 of ($x*)
}
